columns.name: CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: PROVISIONING_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_TP_PARTNER_PROVISNGS

columns.name: APP_ID
columns.description: Unique ID that represents the provisioning application created for the integration

columns.name: APP_URN
columns.description: URN representing the provisioning application created for the integration

columns.name: APP_NAME
columns.description: Name of the provisioning application created for the integration

columns.name: APP_DESC
columns.description: Brief description of the provisioning application created for the integration

columns.name: VALID_DOMAINS
columns.description: List of fully qualified domain names allowed by the partner for the integration

columns.name: INTEGRATION_CONTEXT
columns.description: URN representing the data-integration-context for the integration

columns.name: INTEGRATION_NAME
columns.description: Customer facing name for the integration

columns.name: INTEGRATION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of integration supported by partner

columns.name: TENANT_TYPE
columns.description: Role type needed for the integration

columns.name: ONBOARDING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the code identifying the onboarding status of the integration. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_ONBOARDING_STATUS

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_LI_CONTRACTS.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the code identifying the status of the integration in ORC. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_INTEGRATION_STATUS

columns.name: LAST_ACTIVATED_BY
columns.description: Indicates the user who last activated the integration.

columns.name: LAST_ACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time the integration was last activated.

columns.name: LAST_INACTIVATED_BY
columns.description: Indicates the user who last inactivated the integration.

columns.name: LAST_INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time the integration was last inactivated.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: To store user name sent to the third party (based on integration type column)

columns.name: ADDL_INFO1_LAST_SENT_DATE
columns.description: Store the last time additional information is sent to the third party

columns.name: COMPANY_URL
columns.description: To store company URL to be sent to the third party (based on integration type column)

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: To store integration partner notification status if available for a given integration type. ORA_ENABLED or ORA_DISABLED

columns.name: EASY_APPLY_STATUS_CODE
columns.description:
To store Easy apply status.
Default: ORA_ENABLED. ORA_ENABLED or ORA_DISABLED
